name: Heavy Marbles Box
description: A box-state wrapper (inverse of Bubble Marbles). A heavy box sits inside a metal shell; when it opens the shell explodes, and its marbles then plunge through the funnel, overtake everything in flight, and smash onto the belt first.
howToPlay: Tap the bottom (normal) boxes first. Clearing one opens the shelled Heavy box above it — the metal shell explodes. Then tap the Heavy box: its shelled marbles fall much faster, pass any marbles already in the funnel, reach the conveyor first, and their shells shatter with a big bounce. Use them to rush a colour to the belt ahead of everything else.
author: Marble Sorter Prototyping
